ayah_arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Allah – there is no deity except Him. In Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
tafsir_summary: This verse encourages believers to rely upon Allah’s might and protection, calming the heart during fear.

translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
tafsir_summary: Reminds believers that every difficulty comes with ease, soothing fear and uncertainty.

ayah_arabic: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translation: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
tafsir_summary: Calms those facing fear by reminding that remembrance of Allah brings peace to the heart.

ayah_arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا ۚ هُوَ مَوْلَانَا ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
translation: Say, 'Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector.' And upon Allah let the believers rely.
tafsir_summary: Teaches acceptance of Allah’s decree, easing fear and anxiety over life’s trials.

translation: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
tafsir_summary: This verse symbolizes divine light as guidance that dispels the darkness of fear and doubt.
